documents.title: Doc 74 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 - overtook during VSC period
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 4 - overtook during VSC period

details.fact: Car 4 (Herta) overtook Car 3 (Miyata) at SCL2 during the VSC period.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 41.6 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 2 points
details.reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. During the VSC period, it was reported that Car 4 overtook Car 3 between Turns 1 and 2. Car 4 was on track and Car 3 was leaving the pit lane while the VSC was still active, heading toward Turn 1 and Safety Car Line 2. Upon reaching Safety Car Line 2, Car 3 maintained the lead and crossed the line ahead of Car 4. Therefore, Car 4 was not permitted to overtake Car 3 at that point. The Stewards observed that Car 4 did not give back the position after overtaking Car 3. Consequently, they have decided to impose the standard 10-second time penalty for his actions.

documents.title: Doc 72 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 22 - left the track and gained lasting advantage
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 22 - left the track and gained lasting advantage

details.fact: Car 22 left the track at Turn 1 and went outside of the kerb, using the pit lane exit road.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards reviewed the GPS positioning system and video evidence. Having considered the matter extensively the Stewards determined that at the start of the race Car 22 left the track and went outside of the kerb at Turn 1. While Car 22 re- entered the track safely, this manoeuvre allowed him to overtake Car 2. The Stewards reviewed video evidence and confirmed that Car 22 did not give back the position. documents.title: Doc 64 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 9 - failure to nominate both rear brake discs
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 9 - failure to nominate both rear brake discs

details.fact: The Competitor of Car 9 failed to nominate the front brakes as required by Article 24.18 a of the F2 Sporting regulations.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 24.18 a of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A fine of 7000 Euros (being 2 x 3500 Euros) to be paid by the Competitor. In accordance with Article 12.8.1 of the ISC, fines shall be paid within forty‐eight hours of their notification by means of bank transfer to the FIA. The Competitor must immediately nominate the two brake discs used in Race 1. In addition, two brake discs are removed from their total allocation for the 2026 F2 season, in accordance with Article 28.14 c of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 63) and heard the Team Representative. They examined the report (Document 62) from the Technical Delegate, who was also present at the Hearing at the request of the Stewards Panel. The Team did not dispute the Technical Delegate’s report that Car 9 used brake discs that were not properly nominated for the car as required by Article 24.18a) of the Formula 2 Sporting Regulations. The Team explained that this was an administrative error on their part. Stewards determined that Car 9 gained no Sporting Advantage during the race due to the error. The Stewards accept that administrative errors can occur but determine that an infringement exist nevertheless. Under the circumstances, the Stewards impose a fine of 7,000 Euro on the team and decide to reduce by two the number of brake disks available for the rest of the season (from 36 to 34 total) in accordance to Article 28.14. c) of the Formula 2 Sporting Regulations. The Stewards also mandate the team to declare the two discs used during the race (brake disc number: G5028 & G5029).

documents.title: Doc 61 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - incorrect number of tyres available for the Feature Race
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - incorrect number of tyres available for the Feature Race

details.fact: Car 2 (Durksen) does not have the correct number of tyres to comply with the Sporting Regulations in relation to the Feature Race (Race 2).
details.infringement: Breach of Article 24.15 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A drop of 5 grid places for the Feature Race (Race 2). No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned and heard the team representative (document 60). Having considered the matter extensively and discussed the situation with the Technical Delegate, the Stewards determined that during the Qualifying session, Car 2 rendered the front right tyres of both “option” compound sets of tyres unusable for safety reasons, as certified by the Tyre Supplier. This was deemed by the Stewards to be not for reasons of force majeure. Car 2, is therefore, not able to comply with SR 24.15 for the Feature Race (Race 2). The grid drop of 5 places applies to the Feature Race as this is when the tyre is required to be used. The Stewards direct the Tyre Supplier to provide a new “option” front right tyre to Car 2 for use only in the Feature Race (Race 2). The Tyre Supplier is requested to mount and issue this tyre to the Team for usage in Race 2 (Feature).

documents.title: Doc 59 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 3 - causing a collision
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 3 - causing a collision

details.fact: Car 3 (Miyata) made contact with Car 10 (Goethe) at Turn 7.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: Ten seconds (10) time penalty in accordance with Article 39.3 (b) of the FIA F2 Sporting Regulations. In addition, 2 points to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 3 points
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 57 & 58) and heard the Drivers of Car 3 (Miyata) and Car 10 (Goethe) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence. The Driver of Car 10 explained that approaching Turn 7 he was clearly ahead of Car 3. When entering the corner, Car 3 stuck his front wing on the inside and made contact with the right rear tyre of Car 10. The Driver of Car 3 stated that he was ahead of Car 10 at Turn 6 and that he was squeezed by Car 10 in both the Turn 6 exit and the entry of Turn 7, which resulted in a contact between the two cars. Having considered the matter extensively, Stewards determined that Car 3 initiated an overtaking move on the inside of Car 10 at Turn 7. Video evidence showed that Car 3 made contact from his front axle to the right rear wheel of Car 10. Footage also confirmed that at no point was the front axle of Car 3 alongside the mirror of Car 10, as required in the 2026 Driving Standard Guidelines to have the right of the line when overtaking on the inside The Stewards determined that Car 3 was wholly to blame for the incident and imposed the baseline penalty of 10 seconds penalty plus two penalty points.

documents.title: Doc 46 - INFRINGEMENT - MP MOTORSPORT (Car 10) potentially unsafe act
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - MP MOTORSPORT (Car 10) potentially unsafe act

details.fact: A team member momentarily entered the Fast Lane to release Car 10.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.h of the FIA International Sporting Code - potentially unsafe act.
details.decision: Reprimand to the Team.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Document 36) and heard the Team representative. They examined video evidence. During the qualifying session, a team member momentarily entered the fast lane to release Car 10. For safety reasons, it is essential that team members avoid crossing the white line separating the blending lane from the fast lane. This rule is crucial for maintaining safety and minimizing risks during high-pressure moments on the pit lane. The team manager explained that the limited space provided by the F1 Teams prevented them from having the necessary room to operate effectively. This was confirmed by the Race Director, who explained that a request would be made to improve this for all remaining sessions. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards concluded that, although the team did breach the regulations, there were mitigating circumstances. Specifically, the limited space available contributed to the situation, and the team member was only briefly in the fast lane. Taking these factors into account, the Stewards have decided to issue a reprimand to the team.

documents.title: Doc 41 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - impeded Car 16 in Qualifying
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 2 - impeded Car 16 in Qualifying

details.fact: Car 2 (Duerksen) impeded Car 16 (Maini) at Turn 6 in Qualifying.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 31.6 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: A drop of 3 places on the grid for the Sprint Race & Feature Race at this Competition. No driver penalty points are associated with this infringement.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 30 & 31) and heard the Drivers of Car 2 (Duerksen) and Car 16 (Maini) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence. Car 16 was on push lap and caught up to the back of Car 2 who was on a cool down lap, Car 16 was closing the gap quickly and at Turn 6 caught up with Car 2, who was on the racing line and impeded Car 16. The driver of Car 2 indicated that he had no radio from the team advising him that Car 16 was approaching quickly. Meanwhile, the driver of Car 16 claimed that he was on a push lap and was impeded by Car 2, who remained on the racing line. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards determined that Car 2 could have done more to avoid unnecessarily impeding on Car 16, consequently the Stewards apply the standard penalty of a drop 3 grid positions. This penalty applies for both the Sprint and Feature races, as per Art. 31.6 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.

documents.title: Doc 40 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 16 - causing a collision
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 16 - causing a collision

details.fact: Car 16 (Maini) made contact with Car 24 (Van Hoepen) at Turn 10 in Qualifying.
details.infringement: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 (d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
details.decision: A drop of 3 places on the grid for the Sprint Race & Feature Race at this Competition. In addition, 1 point is to be added to the driver’s record. Total for the 2026 season = 1 point
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 25 & 26) and heard the Drivers of Car 16 (Maini) and Car 24 (Van Hopene) and the team representatives. They examined the GPS information and video evidence. The driver of Car 24 explained that he was on a warm up lap. He also admitted being aware of Car 16 following closely and seeing a blue flag just before Turn 10. He stated that there was no space for Car 16 to overtake him at Turn 10 and he had no time to react to the blue flag as he was already turning for the corner. The driver of Car 16 confirmed that he was also on a warm up lap, but he wanted to get a better position on track and decided to first move to the right of the track and later to the left-hand side and start an overtaking move of Car 25. The Driver of Car 16 admitted making contact with the barriers before making contact with Car 24. Having considered the matter extensively, Stewards determined that Car 16 was too optimistic, trying to overtake Car 24, his front axle was alongside the rear wheel of Car 24 when the contact occurred. The Stewards noted the two blue flags displayed just before Turn 10 while both cars were in sequence at a similar speed and consider this a mitigating circumstance. The Stewards decided that Car 16 was predominantly to blame for the incident and elected to impose a drop of three grid positions for both races at this Competition plus 1 penalty point.

documents.title: Doc 17 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 21 - erratic driving T2-T3 in Practice
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 21 - erratic driving T2-T3 in Practice

details.fact: Car 21 was driving in an erratic manner whilst ahead of Car 16 between Turn 2 and Turn 3 in Practice.
details.infringement: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula 2 Sporting Regulations.
details.decision: Warning given to the Driver of Car 21.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 12 & 13) and heard the Drivers of Car 21 (Shields) and Car 16 (Maini) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence. The driver of Car 16 explained that he was on a build up lap and tried to pass Car 21 at Turn 3, as he (Car 16) was carrying more speed than the car in front. Car 21 moved to the left and both cars were close to making contact. The driver of Car 21 explained that he was also on a build up lap. He looked in his mirrors before reaching Turn 3, and he noticed Car 16 behind him. The Driver of Car 21 admitted that he didn’t expect Car 16 to close the gap so quickly. He moved to the left to negotiate the corner and as soon as he realized that Car 16 was trying to overtake him, the driver of Car 21 opened the steering to avoid making contact. Having considered the matter extensively, Stewards determined that Car 21 moved to the left-hand side of the track in an erratic manner, squeezing Car 16 against the guardrail. Despite there being no contact, the Stewards determined that Car 21 was predominately to blame for the incident and decided to impose warning.

documents.title: Doc 16 - INFRINGEMENT - Car 12 - Practice start procedure violation
documents.subject: INFRINGEMENT - Car 12 - Practice start procedure violation

details.fact: Car 12 was attempting to perform a practice start, but hampered Car 14
details.infringement: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code - failure to follow requirements for Practice Start
details.decision: Warning given to the Driver of Car 21.
details.reason: The Stewards summoned (Documents 14 & 15) and heard the Drivers of Car 12 (Boya) and Car 14 (Stenshorne) and the team representatives. They examined video evidence. Once the session concluded, participants were given the opportunity to do practice starts on the grid. As the cars approached the grid to practice their starts, Car 12 (BOY) was ahead of Car 14 (STE) to find a suitable box on the front rows. The driver of Car 12 (BOY) first moved to the right as he thought cars were leaving the grid faster on that side, then he shifted to the left, putting himself where Car 14 (STE) was going. This sudden manoeuvre created uncertainty for Car 14 (STE) as they prepared for their own practice start. Although the driver of Car 12 (BOY) proceeded with the practice start, he failed to position his car within a designated grid box as required. Having considered the matter extensively, the Stewards concluded that the driver of Car 12 (BOY) failed to meet the requirements outlined by the Race Director Competition Notes (document No. 3) Item 16. Consequently, the Stewards elected to issue a warning to the driver of Car 12.
